name: history-not-recorded
breaks: every capability transition is kept across restarts
red: holds the previous process in its history once restarted, beside this one

name: chain-stops-at-the-last-capability
breaks: the critical chain follows each link back through the prerequisite that came up last
red: follows a critical chain of what each capability waited on to the capability that came up last

name: waits-not-recorded
breaks: a wait names the capability it holds up, and the readout follows it
red: follows a critical chain of what each capability waited on to the capability that came up last

name: blame-unordered
breaks: the blame lists the slowest capability first

edits.from: return rows.sort((a, b) => order(b) - order(a) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

red: blames no capability for still waiting, slowest first

name: no-first-rise
breaks: each capability carries when it first came up
red: reports every capability present on the node up, each with its first rise
